name: Conference Z's Victims
source: Pathfinder Society Scenario #5-11: The Hidden Current
description: The pain of over 300 souls crying out for recognition and revenge pierces through the room, as a spiritual whirlwind fills the space.
disable: DC 30 Medicine check or DC 30 Society check to determine 287's first or surname through the journal text or DC 32 Occultism check or DC 32 Religion check to connect with the spiritual energy bound to the journal to find her name. Two successes are needed, one for each part of 287's name.
reset: The haunt vanishes permanently if 287's name is revealed.
routine: (1 action) The haunt makes a howling wail Strike against all living creatures in area A13 as 1 action.

offensiveAbilities.name: Please, See Me, Too
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger The PCs start investigating the journal for 287's name

Effect The victims all beg for attention and recognition, lashing out at the PCs when they remain focused. The haunt makes a howling wail Strike against all living creatures and then rolls initiative.
